baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatic first-person construction, the doubled ن ز ل occurrence, and قُرْءَان.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated divine subject fixes agency, while the finite descent plus cognate verbal noun makes delivery itself salient. Joined to the recitation branch of ق ر ء, the object is encountered as an enacted and potentially repeated conveyance, not merely as a possessed book.

activation_trace.role: Caused descent and repeated scriptural delivery supply the verse's emphatically performed conveyance.
Reading, reciting, and teaching recitation make the delivered object an event in voices and reception.

changed_reading.before: A completed one-time transfer of a book.
changed_reading.after: An emphatically divine act of making a recitation arrive and continue to be received.

baseline_models.mechanism: The gathering branch of ق ر ء and the proper-placement branch of ن ز ل cooperate: what is gathered is not dropped indiscriminately but arranged and placed in fitting stations upon the recipient.

activation_trace.role: Gathering and joining supply the Qur'an as a composed whole rather than loose units.
Putting a thing in its proper place turns descent into fitted arrangement.

changed_reading.before: Content moves from above to below.
changed_reading.after: A gathered composition is deliberately fitted, ordered, and placed upon its recipient.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The finite نَزَّلْنَا followed by the cognate تَنزِيلًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: One-descent episodes from ن ز ل combine with the appointed-time branch of ق ر ء. The doubled root occurrence can therefore profile a succession of due arrivals rather than an undifferentiated transfer.

activation_trace.role: A single descent as one episode supplies the countable installment unit.
An appointed time arriving or being delayed gives those episodes a due temporal profile.

changed_reading.after: A sequence of individually due revelatory arrivals.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ن ز ل verbal complex directed عَلَيْكَ and the gathered sense available in قُرْءَان.
baseline_models.mechanism: The guest-provision branch of ن ز ل makes the descent something prepared for an arrival, while ق ر ء gathers it into a furnished whole. The recipient can thus be addressed as one hosted by revelation and entrusted with its provision.

activation_trace.role: Prepared hospitality for a guest supplies revelation as furnished provision.
Gathering supplies the collected provision that can be received and passed on.

changed_reading.before: A message delivered to a messenger.
changed_reading.after: Prepared revelatory hospitality laid upon a recipient who may relay it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ as an arrival bearing on the addressee.
baseline_models.mechanism: The severe-event and combat branches of ن ز ل keep open a harder edge: a recited descent may arrive not only as gift but as an event that places its recipient in confrontation.

activation_trace.role: A severe event descending on people supplies the burden or crisis side of revelation.
Coming down to contest supplies a confrontational direction for the arrival.
Public recitation makes the confrontation voiced rather than merely inward.

changed_reading.before: A benign transfer whose main issue is provenance.
changed_reading.after: A voiced arrival that can itself precipitate ordeal and confrontation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's proper-placement and gathering branches meet the precisely fitted measure of 76:16. The cognate-verbal-noun echo makes تَنزِيلًا profile calibrated composition: each delivered part can be fitted to its measure, occasion, and receiver.

activation_trace.role: Proper placement supplies the ordering operation that context can calibrate.
Gathering supplies the composed material whose parts receive measured placement.
Exact fit to a proper measure supplies calibration rather than mere quantity.

structural_cues: 76:16 and 76:23 both use a finite verb followed by its cognate verbal noun.
The measured vessels occur inside the long scene immediately preceding the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact-fit imagery and a repeated grammatical frame; I infer that the echo transfers calibration to revelation's arrangement. The live alternative is that each verbal noun only intensifies an unrelated act.

changed_reading.before: A gathered text is placed in order.
changed_reading.after: The revelation is composed and delivered in portions precisely fitted to their station and capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The long circuit of drinking, feeding others, and being given drink activates ن ز ل as guest-provision. The Qur'an becomes advance hospitality received by the addressee and, by reader inference, provision entrusted for onward distribution.

activation_trace.role: Prepared guest-provision makes descent materially hospitable.
Gathering makes the provision a collected whole available for relay.
An allotted share of water supplies portioned reception rather than indiscriminate abundance.
Feeding another converts received provision into a social relay.
Giving drink to the thirsty closes the reciprocal hospitality circuit at its divine source.

structural_cues: 76:5-21 sustains a banquet and service sequence, and 76:22 names its recompense immediately before 76:23.
Human feeding without requested return is answered by the Lord's direct giving of drink.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated provision, service, and divine return; I infer that the guest-provision branch makes the Qur'an the prior gift that enables a relay through the recipient. It may instead be only the instruction that leads to later hospitality.

changed_reading.before: Revelation is a message addressed to the prophet.
changed_reading.after: Revelation is prepared hospitality given to him in apportioned form so that provision can move onward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus-only installments acquire a lived rhythm from occasion, morning, evening, and night, while haste supplies their rejected opposite. تَنزِيلًا now describes pacing that is embodied by the addressee's repeated remembrance and worship.

activation_trace.role: Gradual descent supplies duration and staged arrival.
One descent as an episode supplies the repeated temporal unit.
An appointed time makes the episodes due rather than accidental.
A thing's occasion opens the surah with bounded temporal arrival.
The first part of day begins the response cycle immediately after the focus.
The evening time supplies the cycle's second daily station.
Sustained practice at night extends reception beyond two daytime points.
Haste and premature advancement supply the temporal pattern that paced descent resists.

structural_cues: 76:23 is followed by patience, morning-evening remembrance, long-night practice, and then rejection of the immediate.
The surah opens with an extended span of time and closes with delayed consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a staged-descent branch and an explicit post-focus schedule; I infer that response rhythm enacts the mode of revelation itself. The alternative is that the schedule regulates only the recipient, not the descent.

changed_reading.before: Revelation arrives in separate due installments.
changed_reading.after: Its paced arrival trains a matching daily and nightly rhythm that opposes demand for the immediate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Qur'an's pattern-and-course branch is activated by guidance to a path at 76:3 and voluntary taking of a path at 76:29. Properly placed descent becomes an executable course: revelation supplies a form to inhabit, not only directions to inspect.

activation_trace.role: A directed manner, pattern, or course supplies the Qur'an as an actionable form.
Proper placement installs that pattern at fitting stations in the recipient's life.
Gentle indication toward the true road supplies orientation at the surah's opening.
An extended traversable path turns orientation into movement.
The path's return after the focus closes the whole-surah traversal.
Taking up a way or form supplies active adoption rather than passive exposure.

structural_cues: The path appears near the beginning at 76:3 and returns near the end at 76:29.
The descent at 76:23 and bodily practices at 76:24-26 stand between being shown the path and taking it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a path frame, a course branch in the focus, and active taking; I infer that the descended Qur'an is the traversable pattern joining them. It may instead only describe or command an independently defined path.

changed_reading.before: A well-ordered body of guidance is delivered.
changed_reading.after: A traversable pattern is installed in stages and becomes real only as the recipient takes it up.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Creator first originates the human and makes hearing and inward sight; the surah then repeatedly makes the addressee see an unseen scene before naming it as delivered Qur'an. Recited descent can therefore function as a second-stage formation that converts hearing into insight and shown vision.

activation_trace.role: Audible recitation supplies the sensory entry point for the formative mechanism.
Proper placement lets recited material be fitted into the faculties it forms.
Creative origination supplies the first formation with which revelatory formation is compared.
Transforming something into a state makes hearing and seeing formed capacities, not incidental traits.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies reception deeper than sound.
Insight of the heart supplies the target state produced through reception.
Causing something to be seen turns the preceding recited description into perceptual disclosure.

structural_cues: 76:2 ends human formation with hearing and seeing, while 76:19-20 repeatedly addresses sight.
76:23 retrospectively identifies the displayed reward scene as part of the Qur'an's delivery.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies created faculties, repeated seeing, and recitation; I infer a causal conversion from heard recitation to inward sight. The alternative is that the sensory cues merely list independent modes of evidence.

changed_reading.before: The Qur'an informs already formed hearers about an unseen scene.
changed_reading.after: Its recited descent continues human formation by making hearing become insight and disclosed vision.

context_deltas.mechanism: Testing that reveals condition, the gratitude-versus-covering polarity, and the immediate refusal of rival obedience activate the focus's severe and combative descent branches. Revelation arrives as an ordeal that exposes allegiance and opens a contest over whom the recipient will obey.

activation_trace.role: A severe event descending upon people supplies revelation as experienced ordeal.
Coming down to contest supplies the confrontation over obedience.
Recitation publicly presents the claim that triggers response.
Testing that makes a condition appear supplies the disclosure function of the ordeal.
Acknowledging a gift supplies one revealed response to the descent.
Concealing truth supplies the opposed response exposed by recitation.
Submission and obedience identify the practical terrain on which the confrontation occurs.

structural_cues: 76:3 establishes grateful and covering responses, while 76:24 immediately derives a non-obedience command from the focus.
76:27 identifies attachment to the immediate as the opposing temporal allegiance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies test, polarized responses, and contested obedience; I infer that the descent itself precipitates their disclosure. It could instead be only the informational instrument used within a separately defined test.

changed_reading.before: The Qur'an arrives with a possible confrontational edge.
changed_reading.after: Its arrival is the ordeal that exposes gratitude or concealment and forces a choice of obedience.

context_deltas.mechanism: The emphatic divine agency in the focus is echoed by the first-person creation claim at 76:28, followed by human taking and nested human-divine willing. Sending the Qur'an becomes the enabling divine initiative within which a real human adoption of the path occurs.

activation_trace.role: Caused delivery supplies the initiating act attributed emphatically to the divine speaker.
Creative origination identifies the same speaker as source of the agent who receives and chooses.
Acquiring or adopting preserves a genuine human act inside the larger initiative.
Will directed toward a thing supplies the explicit nesting of human willing within divine willing.

structural_cues: The marked first-person plural in 76:23 recurs in the creation assertion of 76:28.
76:29 preserves willing and taking, and 76:30 immediately places that willing within divine willing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated agency claims and nested willing; I infer that Qur'anic descent is the enabling initiative that makes path-taking possible without erasing adoption. The alternative is that the emphasis only authenticates provenance.

changed_reading.before: The doubled divine subject mainly certifies who sent the Qur'an.
changed_reading.after: It marks the prior agency that creates the chooser, sends the path-form, and enables without replacing the chooser's taking.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branch of putting a thing in its proper station is opposed at the surah's close by the branch-image of putting a thing in the wrong time or place. Entry into mercy and prepared consequence make tanzil a rectifying placement that orders agents and acts toward fitting destinations.

activation_trace.role: Putting a thing in its proper station supplies the focus's ordering pole.
Movement into an interior supplies the completed destination of right placement.
Tender mercy names the receptive destination into which entry is granted.
Putting something at the wrong time or place supplies the exact material opposite of fitted tanzil.
Preparing equipment or provision supplies the made-ready consequence of the closing placement.

structural_cues: 76:31 closes the whole-surah package with two destinations after revelation and response.
The focus's placement branch and the closing misplacement branch form a cross-root opposition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies proper placement, wrong placement, entry, and preparation; I infer a rectifying and sorting function for tanzil. The alternative is that these are parallel spatial images without a causal relation.

changed_reading.before: The Qur'an's parts are put into their proper compositional places.
changed_reading.after: Its fitted descent also rectifies placement in life, distinguishing a path into mercy from acts that put things out of place.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates reproductive branches of both focus roots and several context polysemes. It remains anchored in ن ز ل, ق ر ء, the opening mixed drop, hidden gestation, children, and the closing womb branch; downstream prose should present it only as a generative material analogy, never as a lexical gloss or biological claim about the Qur'an.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The seminal-discharge branch of ن ز ل and womb-enclosure branch of ق ر ء within the focus's delivery construction.

activation_trace.role: Emission of generative fluid supplies the material release side of delivery.
A womb enclosing pregnancy supplies gathering, containment, and formation before emergence.
Clear fluid ranging from drop to seminal fluid supplies the opening generative substrate.
The mixed generative drop makes formation composite rather than instantaneous.
A fetus hidden inside supplies protected interior development, though it is not the local garden gloss.
Birth and putting down a pregnancy supply emergence into a newly visible state.
The womb branch closes the package with a second enclosure image under the surface wording of mercy.

changed_reading.after: Revelation can be imagined, cautiously, as a deposited and staged formation that gives rise to a newly formed hearer or reciting collective.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the detention branch of ق ر ء is remote from ordinary Qur'an usage and the context bindings are partly punitive. It remains focus-anchored through قُرْءَان and ordered placement, with chains, captivity, bodily cohesion, and contested obedience supplying a coherent material field; downstream prose should call it a counter-binding analogy, not say that Qur'an lexically means a chain.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The holding branch of ق ر ء and proper-placement branch of ن ز ل under عَلَيْكَ.

activation_trace.role: Holding for verification or detention supplies a binding force that can stabilize or constrain.
Proper placement turns that holding into ordered discipline rather than arbitrary restraint.
A collar binding a limb supplies the punitive bond against which a counter-bond can be read.
Binding and detention make captivity a social condition rather than only an object.
Tight bodily formation and cohesive joints supply a constructive form of binding.
Tightening a knot or bond reinforces cohesion as an alternative to punitive chains.
Obedience identifies rival claims from which disciplined attachment to revelation can free the recipient.

changed_reading.before: The Qur'an is laid upon a recipient who remains otherwise unbound.
changed_reading.after: It can be imagined as a constructive counter-bond that holds the recipient together and blocks captivity to rival obedience.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the terrain-and-runoff branch of ن ز ل rather than the standard revelation branch. It remains anchored in the focus's descent and gathering roots and is strongly activated by the surah's springs, bursting flow, and supplied drink; downstream prose should mark the recipient-as-ground mechanism with 'as if' language and not equate Qur'an literally with water.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The branch of ن ز ل in which descent marks terrain, joined to the gathering branch of ق ر ء.

activation_trace.role: Ground marked by descent or runoff makes the recipient a terrain on which arrival leaves productive effects.
Gathering, including collected contents, supplies what the terrain receives before release.
A source of running water supplies the productive outlet formed in the receiving ground.
A broad rupture and outflow supplies release from received descent into abundant circulation.
Providing water turns the outflow into benefit directed to others.

changed_reading.before: The recipient is a container onto which revelation is delivered.
changed_reading.after: The recipient becomes, as if, marked ground where descent gathers, opens a spring, and flows outward as provision.

strongest_changes: The cognate-descent formula became calibrated placement through the exact-measure echo at 76:16.
The banquet sequence activated revelation as prepared provision received for onward relay.
Post-focus temporal practice revised installments into a lived rhythm opposed to haste.
The path frame and nested agency made the Qur'an an executable course enabled by divine initiative rather than a static map.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package made 76:23 a hinge: it retrospectively names the formed sensory, ethical, and hospitable world of 76:1-22 as delivered Qur'an, then prospectively generates the paced obedience, path-taking, willing, and final placement of 76:24-31.
remaining_uncertainties: The cognate verbal noun may mark emphatic completion rather than repeated or calibrated staging.
The provision, perceptual-formation, and right-placement mechanisms may be thematic analogies rather than semantic pressures on تَنزِيلًا.
The gestational, counter-binding, and hydrological outliers depend on deliberately contained branch-distance and should not be rendered as lexical glosses.
